summary: Added the current reconstruction checkpoint main_xtal_pw20_epoch20_heads25.pth (weights only: main_xtal_pw20 epoch 20 + 25 direction heads) and its profile configs/main_xtal_pw20_ep20_heads25.json; results and lineage in provenance/main_xtal_pw20_artifacts.json.

models/main.py: optional direction-head ensemble (PURITY_DIR_HEADS, default 0 = unchanged); with N heads the event summary's polar angle and its theta < 120 deg acceptance use the average of their polar angles.

models/main.py: identification leniency settings PURITY_POS_TRIG_THR, PURITY_POS_MIP_THR, PURITY_HTP_MIN_HITS (defaults 0.5, 0.5, 2 = the trained behaviour); __main__.py pins them and PURITY_DIR_HEADS in every profile.
models/main.py, models/layers.py: hit-anchored endpoints (HitEndpointHead, PURITY_HIT_ENDPOINTS) and the gate dead zones used by the current model.
New package purity.training.direction_heads: dump the frozen network's head inputs, train sets of heads, build the checkpoint.

training/main.py, train_utils.py: hit-endpoint loss; --role_ce_positron_weight (the ramp target honours it), --chain_exclusive_anchor, --role_ce_focal_gamma, --role_lr / --role_group_builder, oversampling of flagged hard topologies (--oversample_flags / --oversample) and brem transplant augmentation (--brem_donors, purity.augment, preprocessing.brem_donors); defaults reproduce the previous trainer.
scripts/slurm/train_main.sbatch: passes exported PURITY_* settings and TRAIN_EXTRA; PHASE=3 trains the pw20 stage.

Preprocessing: LYSO hits at crystal positions (root_to_parquet; lyso_crystal_positions for existing parquets, with assets/luts/lyso_crystal_polys.npz), Geant4 centroids kept as lyso_truth_x/y/z and carried by the mixer; LYSO trigger threshold applied to merged crystal hits; channel_merge for hits one channel reads as a single pulse; hard_event_flags for oversampling.
README and docs/training.md describe the current model and its recipe.
